customer: Hi, I'm hoping to sell my hybrid sedan before I move for school, but I put in a custom stereo and some tinted trim a while back. Would those upgrades help my offer at all? Thanks so much for any guidance!
agent: Thanks for reaching out! As our article "Cars with aftermarket modifications" explains, aftermarket changes rarely add value and can sometimes lower an offer, since we may need to return the car to factory condition. If there's anything you'd like to keep, like your custom stereo, please remove it before the appraisal. And if a modification does change your offer, the specialist will show you why.
